column1: # The entity variables (the names the Var functions of the entity classes compare, with the start the dispatch puts
# before a part's names: AI_, LLogic, Hit_, Traf_, InCtrl_; and the names the scripts set): name, tag, why. A name
# may end in '*' (a family by its start) or hold '#' for a run of digits. Tags: STATE (part of what a client shows:
# replicate the value, the journal of the entity keeps it), EVENT (a one-shot trigger: replicate the set as an
# event), SIM (a simulation value that changes the world on the server only and reaches the client through other
# state, or a value that is only read), SERVER_ONLY (server bookkeeping a client never needs: script callbacks,
# logic and AI states and targets), CLIENT_ONLY (the client's own view: cameras, look). netclass.py counts the rows
# without a tag (an error from stage 3.2).
